verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!

segments.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!

verses.text: You have granted his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah

segments.text: You have granted his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah

verses.text: For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.

segments.text: For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.

verses.text: He asked You for life, and You granted it—length of days, forever and ever.

segments.text: He asked You for life, and You granted it—length of days, forever and ever.

verses.text: Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.

segments.text: Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.

verses.text: For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.

segments.text: For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.

verses.text: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.

segments.text: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.

verses.text: Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.

segments.text: Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.

verses.text: You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.

segments.text: You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.

verses.text: You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.

segments.text: You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.

verses.text: Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.

segments.text: Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.

verses.text: For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.

segments.text: For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.

verses.text: Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.

segments.text: Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.
